services.name: Invisalign Clear Aligners
services.blurb: Invisalign clear aligner treatment planned and supervised in-office. Straighten teeth discreetly without brackets or wires; digital scans, no goopy impressions

services.name: Teeth Whitening
services.blurb: Professional teeth whitening with custom take-home trays or in-office treatment. ADA-approved methods calibrated to your enamel; results in about two visits

services.name: Porcelain Veneers
services.blurb: Custom porcelain veneers that reshape chipped, stained, or uneven front teeth into a natural, durable smile — planned with smile-design photography

services.name: Dental Implants
services.blurb: Dental implant restoration to replace missing teeth with a natural look and bite. Planning, placement coordination, and the final crown handled with 3D imaging

services.name: CEREC Same-Day Crowns
services.blurb: Porcelain crowns designed, milled, and bonded in one visit with CEREC — no impressions sent away, no temporary crown, no two-week wait

services.name: Dental Exams & Cleanings
services.blurb: Thorough exams and professional cleanings with digital X-rays and oral cancer screening. The foundation visit for every new patient

services.name: Composite Fillings
services.blurb: Tooth-colored composite fillings that repair decay and small fractures invisibly — matched to your enamel shade

services.name: Dentures & Partial Dentures
services.blurb: Full and partial dentures custom-fitted for comfort and a natural appearance, with adjustment visits included

services.name: Fixed Bridges
services.blurb: Fixed porcelain bridges that permanently replace one or more missing teeth without removable appliances

services.name: Periodontal (Gum) Care
services.blurb: Gum disease treatment from deep cleanings (scaling and root planing) through maintenance visits — protect teeth and bone before damage spreads

services.name: Gum & Bone Grafting
services.blurb: Gum grafting for recession and bone grafting to rebuild support for teeth and implants, performed in-office with local anesthetic

services.name: Crown Lengthening
services.blurb: Surgical crown lengthening to reshape a gummy smile or expose more tooth for a crown — often paired with veneers for final proportions
